subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) The tension of the war hung in the air. (b) She switched on the radio. (c) It was the eve of the World War II, October 1938. (d) Her husband William Smith and son William Smith Junior were off to the border. (e) A deep male voice floated in. It was an invasion alarm. (f) Mrs. Smith sat on her favourite rocking chair and closed her eyes. It was a long tiring day. (g) Mrs, Smith was restless.
